'''2000 DecipherCon Japanese Sealed Deck (7 October)''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck held in Kissimmee, Florida on 7 October 2000. It is known from Geoff Snider's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1309">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-08-deciphercon-2000d1309/ deciphercon-2000], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 8 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-08-deciphercon-2000d1309/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[DecipherCon 2000]].

* '''Date:''' 7 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Kissimmee, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Japanese Sealed Deck]]
